item: A1. Guangdong Guangning Guangbei: real Chinese name
note_zh: 這筆的中文名「吉安市青原區富灘風電場項目（一期富灘風電場項目）」是江西吉安的風場，英文名與座標卻在廣東肇慶廣寧縣；GEM 唯一的出處 h0758.net（肇慶本地網站）連不上（https 斷線、http 503），查不到廣寧這座 48 MW 風場的中文名與業主。
note_en: The Chinese name on this record (Ji’an Qingyuan Futan, phase 1) is a Jiangxi farm, while its English name and point are in Guangning, Zhaoqing, Guangdong. GEM’s only source, h0758.net (a Zhaoqing site), is unreachable (https dropped, http 503), so the real Chinese name and owner of this 48 MW Guangning farm were not found.
why: Blocked: h0758.net. Web search (English-only engine) returns nothing for 广宁 广北; Bing/DDG/Baidu block scripted searches here. Not proposed: clearing the zh name would need to know whether the Chinese name or the English name/location is the wrong half (it could also be a misplaced Futan phase-1 row).

sources.quote: Guangdong Guangning Guangbei wind farm is an operating wind farm in Guangning, Zhaoqing, Guangdong, China.

item: A2. Jiangxi Qingyuan Futan: which phase is which
note_zh: GEM 的富灘頁：別名「青原區風光儲一體化項目」，一期 45 MW 運轉中、二期 45 MW 已公布，業主江西聯合能源 70%、吉安青源發展 30%。兩筆共用二期的中文名；GEM 的出處（吉安市自然資源局 bnr.jian.gov.cn 503、chengezhao 404、北極星有驗證碼）都讀不到，無法確定運轉中的是哪一期。
note_en: GEM’s Futan page: other name “Qingyuan District wind-solar-storage project”, phase 1 45 MW operating, phase 2 45 MW announced, owners Jiangxi United Energy 70% and Ji’an Qingyuan Development 30%. Both rows carry the phase-2 Chinese name; GEM’s sources (Ji’an natural-resources bureau 503, chengezhao 404, bjx captcha) cannot be read, so which phase operates is unproven.
why: Blocked: bnr.jian.gov.cn (503), chengezhao.com (404), bjx (Aliyun captcha), weixin. Likely fix once sourced: operating row zhname = phase 1 name (the one now on the Guangning record).

item: A4. Laizhou Huaneng distributed phases 1 and 2
farm: Shandong Laizhou Huaneng distributed wind farm
note_zh: 萬華化學與華能合資的華能（萊州）新能源 93 MWp 分散式風電：一期 48 MW（16 部 3 MW），一、二期年上網電量合計 2.1 億度（2022-11 報導，用語像兩期都已運轉）。仍無各期併網日期，GEM 一期擱置、二期運轉的標示無法核對。
note_en: The Huaneng–Wanhua Laizhou 93 MWp distributed project: phase 1 48 MW (16 × 3 MW), with phases 1 and 2 together sending out about 210 GWh a year (Nov 2022 report, worded as if both run). No per-phase connection dates; GEM’s “phase 1 shelved, phase 2 operating” still cannot be checked.
why: Wanhua’s cninfo announcements have nothing on Laizhou wind; in-en/bjx blocked. The pedaily item suggests phase 1 exists, so a status swap is plausible but not proven.

sources.quote: 该项目一期的装机容量48MWp,共16台单机容量3000KW的风力发电机,年上网量与项目二期共计达2.1亿度

note_zh: 共用的座標（39.0085、117.7143）在 GEM 兩頁都標為概略位置，是濱海新區的代用點（小王莊鎮在其南方約 40 km），不能當作重疊的證據。龍源這筆的營運者是天津龍源新能源開發，三期是國家能源集團新能源（神華天津）。國華小王莊 96 MW（44 部）2018 年 10 月 30 日全部併網，就是 GEM 的一、二期（97 MW、2018）；小王莊鎮到 2021 年底光電與風電合計 150 MW。是否重複仍未證實。
note_en: The shared point (39.0085, 117.7143) is marked approximate on both GEM pages and is a Binhai New District placeholder (Xiaowangzhuang town lies about 40 km south), so it is no evidence of overlap. The Longyuan row is operated by Tianjin Longyuan New Energy Development; phase 3 by CHN Energy New Energy (Shenhua Tianjin). Guohua’s Xiaowangzhuang 96 MW (44 turbines) was fully connected on 30 Oct 2018 = GEM phases 1–2 (97 MW, 2018); the town had 150 MW of solar and wind by end-2021. Overlap still unproven.
why: No source names a Longyuan farm at Xiaowangzhuang; in-en, dlzb (502) and bjx (captcha) blocked. Longyuan’s 2023 annual report shows Tianjin capacity unchanged at 538 MW (2022–2023) but no farm list.

item: A7. Heilongjiang Bayan 200 MW vs Huadian Bayan phases 1-2
note_zh: GEM 這筆（黑龍江巴彥 200MW 風電項目，規劃中）的出處是國家能源集團招標網的公告與北極星「金風、三一預中標！國能 600MW 風機採購項目開標！」，指向國能（國家能源集團）的專案，不是華電；華電哈爾濱巴彥一期 100 MW 2022 年核准（九洲集團公告）。兩者座標相距不到 1 km，但業主不同，不能當作重複。
note_en: GEM’s sources for this row (“Heilongjiang Bayan 200MW wind project”, pre-construction) are a CHN Energy tender notice and a bjx story titled “Goldwind and Sany pre-selected: Guoneng 600 MW turbine purchase opened”, pointing to a CHN Energy (Guoneng) project, not Huadian; Huadian’s Harbin Bayan phase 1 (100 MW) was approved in 2022 (Jiuzhou notice). The points are under 1 km apart, but the owners differ, so no dup.
why: chnenergybidding.com.cn (403/503), wind.imarine.cn (403) and bjx (captcha) unreadable, so the CHN Energy project’s site and status could not be confirmed. Leaning: separate project (keep).

why: No per-farm capacity on Baldota’s pages; Baldota’s 2015 report only via web.archive.org (403 here). A dup needs a source giving the Harapanahalli farm’s capacity by company.

item: C. PTC Energy’s five farms: years
proposal: (no change yet; same for Devenkonda, Molagavalli (PTC), Kandimallayapalli, Payalakuntla)
note_zh: PTC India 2016–17 年報（BSE 公開 PDF）：五座風場合計 238.8 MW 於 2016–17 財年「依約定時程在 2017-03-31 前商轉」，沒有逐場日期；2017–18 年報的借款表寫出機組廠商（Devenkonda ReGen 49.5 MW、Bableshwar Gamesa 50 MW）。年份仍是 2016 或 2017。另注意：Hero 的 Bableshwar（50 MW，25 部 Gamesa G114，2017-03）與 PTC 的 Bableshwar（50 MW Gamesa）同村同規模，可能是同一 Gamesa 園區的兩塊，未查證。
note_en: PTC India’s 2016–17 annual report (public BSE PDF): the five farms (238.8 MW) were commissioned in fiscal 2016–17 “as per the agreed schedule by 31.03.2017”, with no per-farm dates; the 2017–18 report’s loan notes give the OEMs (Devenkonda ReGen 49.5 MW, Bableshwar Gamesa 50 MW). The year is still 2016 or 2017. Note: Hero’s Bableshwar (50 MW, 25 Gamesa G114, March 2017) and PTC’s Bableshwar (50 MW Gamesa) share village and size; they may be two blocks of one Gamesa park, unchecked.
why: Per-project CODs would need APERC/KERC PPA orders or the AP High Court tariff judgments (not reached this round); ptcindia.com fails TLS. BSE annual-report PDFs (bseindia.com/bseplus/AnnualReport/532524/…) are a new working route.
